title: Calibration date
passage:
When should we calibrate the wrench used to tighten bolts?
A. On the second shelf.
B. The label says next Thursday.
C. The handle is blue.
passageZh:
用來鎖緊螺栓的扳手該在什麼時候校正？
A. 在第二層架上。
B. 標籤上寫的是下星期四。
C. 握柄是藍色的。
